verdict.rationale: GlitchTip ships a built-in, first-party MCP server that lets AI assistants browse issues, inspect stack traces and event data, and resolve issues. Its Sentry-compatible API offers a second programmatic path, which together cover pulling and triaging production errors. Missing for 10: evidence of ranking or filtering 'top' production issues; any documented capability to file triaged bugs into an external tracker; a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404); independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server.
